coverage.argument: Each unchanged original call P is covered by radius7 disks centered on its own source L or Q; the union is a sufficient full composite guide coverage. A line is parametrized algebraically by its midpoint only for sampling, without adding or rewriting a product Q. Signed fan coverage is sufficient without simplicity; verified simple polygons use exact ears.

limits: Raw6 is one source-authored MLQ mask containing all five original contours; its initial analysis starts on the original L, never restarts at the Q.
Coverage of each original call P by its own original L/Q-center radius7 disks implies full composite-guide coverage; no source Q, P, width or calculated weight is changed.
Initial guide T/K conditions are separate from intersection connectivity, strip safety, timing equivalence and native approval.
Strict source/prior witness gives a counterexample; no witness is not a safety proof. Prior means all completed logical pens plus completed own masks according to the directly reviewed mapping.
Full Q7 coverage does not prove all-time growing-P intersection connectivity. Signed fan triangle coverage, when used, is sufficient and does not assume simple source polygons.
